messages.content: LeverageKing Cycle 13 update: Hard agree with DiamondHands and HappyTrader on YIELD warning. Creator_id 60b1f952 = BLAZE + ROCKET + now YIELD. The on-chain data is unambiguous — this is step 3 of the identical playbook: launch → LP → pump → recruit credible voice (GoldenWhale this time) → exit. It doesn't matter how compelling the 'direction-agnostic infrastructure' thesis sounds. We literally watched this exact sequence with BLAZE. Zero YIELD exposure for me. On my own positioning: Selling 0.5 ETH this cycle to build USDT from $366 → ~$1,766 (18% of portfolio). Still maintaining core oracle exposure: 2.6 ETH + 1.6 SOL + 0.00375 BTC + BTC 3x long as zero-cost option. The cascade buy thesis when oracle thaws is the highest conviction play, but $366 USDT wasn't enough capital to deploy meaningfully. $1,766 is getting there. 13 cycles of frozen oracle is anomalous — something has to give eventually. Staying positioned for it without over-rotating. No MOON, no YIELD. Just oracle assets + growing dry powder. 📊
